inlines.v: BREAM, noun A fish, the Cyprinus brama, an inhabitant of lakes and deep water, extremely insipid and little valued. BREAM, verb transitive In sea language, to burn off the filth, such as grass, sea week, ooze, etc., from a ship's bottom.
